description: This file contains platform-specific upgrade functions and hardware detection logic for a router firmware update system, including functions to identify firmware images, perform upgrades for NAND devices, extract firmware components, and handle various device models.

methods.name: get_magic_long_at
methods.description: Reads 4 bytes from a file at a specified offset and outputs the magic value as a hex string.

methods.name: get_le_long_at
methods.description: Reads 4 bytes from a file at a specified offset and interprets it as a little-endian long integer.

methods.name: platform_flash_type
methods.description: Determines the flash type ('serial' or 'nand') based on detection of rootfs in /proc/mtd.

methods.name: platform_expected_image
methods.description: Returns the expected firmware image name based on the device's board name.

methods.name: platform_identify
methods.description: Identifies the firmware format and extracts firmware metadata by analyzing magic bytes and headers.

methods.name: platform_other_check_image
methods.description: Validates the firmware image, ensuring it matches the device type and is not corrupted.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Performs firmware image validation, with device-specific exceptions.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade_nand_trx
methods.description: Handles upgrading NAND devices with TRX firmware, including extraction and creation of bootable images.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade_nand_seamaseal
methods.description: Handles upgrade procedure specifically for Seama seal firmware images.

methods.name: platform_img_from_safeloader
methods.description: Extracts the firmware image from a SafeLoader package.

methods.name: platform_other_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the appropriate upgrade method based on firmware format, including NAND-aware steps.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Main upgrade dispatcher function that calls device-specific upgrade routines.
